verses.text: When Israel was a child, I loved him, and out of Egypt I called My son.

segments.text: When Israel was a child, I loved him, and out of Egypt I called My son.

verses.text: But the more I called Israel, the farther they departed from Me. They sacrificed to the Baals and burned incense to carved images.

segments.text: But the more I called Israel, the farther they departed from Me. They sacrificed to the Baals and burned incense to carved images.

verses.text: It was I who taught Ephraim to walk, taking them by the arms, but they never realized that it was I who healed them.

segments.text: It was I who taught Ephraim to walk, taking them by the arms, but they never realized that it was I who healed them.

verses.text: I led them with cords of kindness, with ropes of love; I lifted the yoke from their necks and bent down to feed them.

segments.text: I led them with cords of kindness, with ropes of love; I lifted the yoke from their necks and bent down to feed them.

verses.text: Will they not return to the land of Egypt and be ruled by Assyria because they refused to repent?

segments.text: Will they not return to the land of Egypt and be ruled by Assyria because they refused to repent?

verses.text: A sword will flash through their cities; it will destroy the bars of their gates and consume them in their own plans.

segments.text: A sword will flash through their cities; it will destroy the bars of their gates and consume them in their own plans.

verses.text: My people are bent on turning from Me. Though they call to the Most High, He will by no means exalt them.

segments.text: My people are bent on turning from Me. Though they call to the Most High, He will by no means exalt them.

verses.text: How could I give you up, O Ephraim? How could I surrender you, O Israel? How could I make you like Admah? How could I treat you like Zeboiim? My heart is turned within Me; My compassion is stirred!

segments.text: How could I give you up, O Ephraim? How could I surrender you, O Israel? How could I make you like Admah? How could I treat you like Zeboiim? My heart is turned within Me; My compassion is stirred!

verses.text: I will not execute the full fury of My anger; I will not destroy Ephraim again. For I am God and not man—the Holy One among you—and I will not come in wrath.

segments.text: I will not execute the full fury of My anger; I will not destroy Ephraim again. For I am God and not man—the Holy One among you—and I will not come in wrath.

verses.text: They will walk after the LORD; He will roar like a lion. When He roars, His children will come trembling from the west.

segments.text: They will walk after the LORD; He will roar like a lion. When He roars, His children will come trembling from the west.

verses.text: They will come trembling like birds from Egypt and like doves from the land of Assyria. Then I will settle them in their homes, declares the LORD.

segments.text: They will come trembling like birds from Egypt and like doves from the land of Assyria. Then I will settle them in their homes, declares the LORD.

verses.text: Ephraim surrounds Me with lies, the house of Israel with deceit; but Judah still walks with God and is faithful to the Holy One.
